description: This circular walk takes you around the Woodland Trust's Merry Hill near Bushey in Hertfordshire. On Merry Hill you will fine pleasant trails taking you through meadows and woodland. It's a fine spot with some lovely views over the surrounding town's, villages and countryside of the area. At the southern end of the common you can take a detour to visit Harrow Weald Common and visit the splendid Harrow Viewpoint and the historic Bentley Priory. The hill is a nice spot for dog walking but can get muddy during wetter months.
